description: A 3HP priority selector: its output goes high when high is true, or when low and raise are both true

inputs.text: A voltage above 0V counts as true; with raise also true it takes output to 10V
A voltage above 0V counts as true; with low also true it takes output to 10V
A voltage above 0V counts as true, and takes output to 10V on its own

outputs.text: 10V while high is true, or while low and raise are both true; 0V otherwise

notes: Mono only: a polyphonic cable patched in is read as its first channel alone, and each output carries one channel
